note: Private RV camp and cabins in spruce and redwood forest off Patrick's Point Drive north of Trinidad, about a mile's walk from the bluffs and beaches. Sites are narrow, close together and back-in only; the operator warns they are tight to back into. Monthly rates are offered and the park caters to summer fishermen, but most sites book by the night. --Claude
summary: Sylvan Harbor: $32.50/$39.50 posted (plus 14% tax, 8% service fee; ~$48 all-in, under the gate); Google 4.7/130. Park With Us engine: 70 back-in RV sites (30/50 A FHU, 20-40 ft), 50 bookable online, 1-night minimum, 29-night max; nightly share ~63% (55 of 87 bookable) - passes, no caveat. Not waterfront kept; stored note's 'private beach access trail' is contradicted by the operator FAQ.
flags: LONG-STAY: monthly rates posted ($575/month + electric). Five tests: (1) $39.50 + 14% tax + 8% fee ~ $48 - pass; (2) nightly rate on own site + phone + Park With Us selling 1 night - pass; (3) minimum 1 night - pass; (4) 55 of 87 units bookable online by the night (50 of 70 RV, 5 of 8 tent) ~63% - pass, no caveat band; (5) not a home community - pass. Home-page wording 'We enjoy hosting travelers year-round, but cater to summer seasonal guests, especially fishermen' is not wording that discourages nightly guests - reported, not a drop candidate.
SITES: stored max_rig_ft 32 (note prose) -> 40 (engine max_length; most sites 25-35 ft, 3 bookable at 20 ft). Stored count 73 -> 78 (70 RV + 8 RV-basic).

WATERFRONT: 'not waterfront' kept. Operator FAQ: 'Does the camp have ocean views or beach access? No. We are located about 1 mile or a 20 min walk from gorgeous bluffs and beaches.' Houses and a residential strip lie between camp and shore, which rules out coastal walk. The stored note's 'private beach access trail' was wrong and is removed.
ACCESS: operator says every site is 'tight and challenging to back into' - in the note, not a drop.
